# Research notes: US x Iran effective ceasefire by August 31 (as of 2026-08-08)

**Summary:** The last US strikes on Iran I could confirm were the "heavy wave" of July 29-30. If that was the last qualifying action, the 14-day period runs to about noon ET on August 12, which matches this question's resolution time. A US strike that hits Iranian soil before then resets the clock. Several Polymarket pages and CENTCOM pages could not be fetched (the proxy refused them), so some dates come from search snippets.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. The outcome depends on a "consensus of resolution sources", meaning news reporting and CENTCOM releases on US air or missile strikes that hit Iranian land.
- 2026-07-15: The Polymarket market behind this question is "US x Iran Effective Ceasefire by...? (2 week pause)". [polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042)
- I could not open CENTCOM's releases page or the Polymarket page directly.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-07-29/30: The last qualifying US strike I could confirm. CENTCOM reported finishing a wave of strikes at about 10 p.m. ET on July 29, in retaliation for an Iranian "attempted surprise attack" on US forces in Jordan. Al Jazeera reported a "heavy wave" hitting Qeshm and Bushehr. Iranian media said a strike on a house in Qeshm killed three people. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/us-hits-multiple-targets-in-iran-as-irgc-pledges-retaliation-what-we-know), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/30/nx-s1-5913077/us-iran-updates), [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-07-30/news-1Pcg2L8su6k/p.html)
- 2026-07-31: Iran struck a US-used air base in Kuwait, calling it retaliation for the US strikes "a day earlier". [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/31/irgc-strikes-us-targets-in-kuwait-a-day-after-us-hits-iran-latest-events)
- 2026-08-01: CNN said no US strikes inside Iran had been reported in several days. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/01/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- Timing: if the last strike is dated July 29 ET, day 1 of the period is July 30 and it completes at noon ET on August 12. If the Qeshm strike is dated July 30 ET, it completes August 13. Iran's local morning of July 30 is the evening of July 29 ET.
- I found no reported US strike on Iranian territory between July 31 and August 8. Nothing has settled the question yet.

- 2026-08-04: Trump cited "very good discussions" but warned strikes would resume if Iran backs out. Iran denies negotiating directly with the US. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/04/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-03: Trump said talks would start Monday and called it Iran's "last chance". [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/3/iran-war-live-trump-says-talks-set-to-begin-tehran-urges-us-to-honour-mou)
